_doc: Season windows — the single authoritative definition of when PJL's seasonal
services run. Lives here at the repo root alongside pricing.json / parts.json,
and is read by server/lib/seasons.js. Edit the JSON, not the code.
Before this file existed, the fall window was hardcoded in server/lib/outreach.js
as Sep 1 - Dec 15. The real fall 2026 season ends Nov 6 (hard frost); the last 39
days of that window were not serviceable, which made 'is this customer already
booked for fall?' unreliable and put December dates in front of the operator.
SHAPE
defaults[season]  - year-agnostic fallback, MM-DD. Applies to any year with no
entry under `years`. These carry the ORIGINAL pre-2026 dates
so historical and future years behave exactly as they did
before this file existed.
years[YYYY][season] - full YYYY-MM-DD dates, overriding the default for that
year. Add a new year by adding a block here; no code change.
FIELDS (per season)
serviceableFrom      First day a truck rolls. Inclusive.
serviceableThrough   Last day a truck rolls. Inclusive. Hard frost stop in fall.
publicBookingThrough Last day the public flow accepts a self-serve booking.
Intentionally earlier than serviceableThrough in fall 2026
(Oct 30 vs Nov 6), reserving Nov 1-6 for admin placement so
there is routing room at season end.
NOTHING CONSUMES THIS FIELD YET. It is defined ahead of the
seasonal gate planned for server/lib/availability.js, so that
gate has one source to read rather than a second copy of the
dates. Where no admin-reserved tail is defined, it equals
serviceableThrough.
TIMEZONE
These are plain calendar dates in America/Toronto, PJL's operating timezone.
Consumers compare them against local date fields; server.js pins process.env.TZ
= America/Toronto at boot so that math is honest. See server/lib/seasons.js.
WARNING
A year with no block here inherits `defaults`, which still ends fall on Dec 15.
Add each year's real frost date as the season is planned.
